$comment: Issue #1265: operations documented in docs/openapi.yaml that the indexer does not register.
The coverage check (scripts/check-openapi-route-coverage.js) fails when a documented
operation is not registered, unless it is listed here with an owner and a reason.
Entries are ratcheted: the check fails if an entry is no longer documented, or if the
indexer starts serving it (and also when it is registered at the documented path).
